Nora (product): Quick design sync: proposal for the secret reveal & undo UX on the Credentials page. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/secret-reveal
Nora (product): Goals: (1) make first-time secret access discoverable after create, (2) avoid accidental long-term exposure, (3) give a clear undo for soft-revoke, (4) handle RBAC disabled reveal cases.
Gabe (design): Sketch: post-create ephemeral drawer that shows the secret with a one-time copy button + banner: "This secret will only be shown once". Add an inline checkbox "I saved this secret" that enables the final Done CTA.
Ivy (eng): Backend constraints: we can return the raw secret once from POST /v1/keys -> response includes secret field and flag one_time=true. After that, secret is never returned again. For rotate we generate a new one similarly. We'll also emit audit event key.secret.view with actor id.
Sofia (content): Microcopy: Banner = "This secret is shown only once. Copy it now; we won't be able to show it again." Copy button tooltip: "Copied to clipboard (expires in 30s)". For the checkbox label: "I have saved this secret securely". Toast after copy: "Secret copied. It will not be shown again."
Rex (a11y): For keyboard-only and screenreaders, the drawer must focus first focusable element (copy button), announce the one-time restriction via aria-live, and when the user checks the confirmation box show an accessible status update. Provide an option to download a CSV with the secret (also announced) but ensure it's flagged for screenreaders as sensitive.
Gabe (design): Reveal edge cases: 1) user loses session before checking the checkbox -> show ephemeral summary in credential details: "Secret was generated but not confirmed. You can rotate to get a new secret." 2) mobile: full-screen modal instead of drawer.
Ivy (eng): Implementation: if user navigates away without confirming, we mark key.state = "unconfirmed". rotate endpoint: POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate?regen=true returns new one_time secret. Also support query param ?download=true to return a CSV link in response. Security note: CSV link must be single-use and expire in 60s.
Sofia (content): For unconfirmed state copy: "Secret generated but not saved. If you need the secret, rotate to get a new one-time value." For the credential row: add pill: "secret not saved" with tooltip "Rotate to reveal new secret".
Rex (a11y): Avoid forcing mouse-only interactions. The checkbox must be reachable and label clickable. For the CSV option, ensure the file name is announced and the download anchor has rel="noopener" and proper accessible name.
Ivy (eng): Audit + security: every reveal attempt logs key.secret.view event; downloads log key.secret.download. We should also rate-limit reveals (5 per hour) and show a friendly error: "Secret reveal limit reached. Contact admin."
Gabe (design): Revoke/soft-delete undo: on soft-revoke we show a 10-day banner with an Undo CTA. Undo does a POST /v1/keys/:id/undo-revoke -> returns 200. On hard revoke require typing CONFIRM and show more severe copy.
Sofia (content): Soft-revoke banner copy: "Key disabled ends for 10 days. Undo" -> better: "Key disabled. You can undo this action within 10 days." Hard revoke confirmation: "Type the key name to permanently revoke this secret."
Rex (a11y): For the undo banner, use aria-live=polite and make Undo keyboard-focusable. Also ensure the CONFIRM input has clear aria-describedby explaining permanence.
infra-bot: Event logged -> EV-2187654-01 key.secret.view=1
Nora (product): Action items: @Gabe update mocks (drawer + mobile modal + undo banner), @Ivy add one_time secret contract + rate limits, @Sofia finalize microcopy for banners/toasts, @Rex produce a11y checklist for reveal/download/undo. Aim to ship these in the next sprint. :white_check_mark:
